llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous characteristics of a scam, including an unrealistically broad product range across categories (electronics, luxury, collectibles), unprofessional and unverifiable business contact info, and lack of proper hyperlinks and corporate/legal disclosure typical of legitimate e-commerce. Multiple suspicious subdomains exist on the same parent domain (mechanth.shop), with external sources flagging similar domains as likely scams. The site template appears reused, and there is no way to verify business legitimacy. These facts align with many typical traits of fake online shopping scams.
